title: Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting
title_zh: 通过点轨迹预测学习4D世界

paragraphs.en: 通过点轨迹预测学习4D世界 Reliable multi-view forecasting requires videos from different cameras to describe the same evolving 3D scene. To this end, we introduce Video-Point Model (VPM), a world model that conditions on multi-view video histories and a language instruction to jointly forecast future videos from arbitrary viewpoints and the 3D trajectories of persistent scene points. We extend a pretrained world model with camera-conditioned multi-view processing that integrates complementary observations across cameras, and add a trajectory head that predicts how physical points move through time. Each trajectory tracks a single point across all views, and supervising these trajectories alongside video generation therefore anchors appearance changes in every camera to a shared description of 3D motion. To support training and evaluation, we build VPM-Data, a simulation corpus pairing synchronized multi-view videos with persistent point trajectories, and VP-WorldBench, a forecasting benchmark spanning simulated and real environments. We further extend VPM to robot control by adding robot actions as a token modality in the generator. Action tokens share the point-supervised backbone and are denoised jointly with future videos, thereby grounding the policy in the same 3D-aware representation. On VP-WorldBench and existing 4D generation benchmarks, point supervision improves both video fidelity and 3D motion accuracy over a video-only counterpart, and in simulated and real-robot experiments, it also raises the manipulation success of the action-enabled model.
paragraphs.zh: 通过点轨迹预测学习4D世界 可靠的多视角预测需要来自不同相机的视频来描述同一个不断演化的3D场景。 为此，我们提出了视频-点模型（Video-Point Model，VPM），这是一个世界模型，它以多视角视频历史和一条语言指令为条件，联合预测来自任意视角的未来视频以及场景中持久点的3D轨迹。 我们在预训练世界模型的基础上扩展了相机条件化的多视角处理模块，以整合来自不同相机的互补观测，并添加了一个轨迹头，用于预测物理点随时间的运动。 每条轨迹在所有视角中追踪同一个点，因此在视频生成的同时对这些轨迹进行监督，能够将每个相机中的外观变化锚定到一个共享的3D运动描述上。 为支持训练与评估，我们构建了VPM-Data，一个将同步的多视角视频与持久点轨迹配对的仿真语料库，以及VP-WorldBench，一个涵盖仿真与真实环境的预测基准。 我们进一步通过在生成器中将机器人动作作为一种token模态加入，把VPM扩展到机器人控制。 动作token共享点监督的主干网络，并与未来视频一起进行去噪，从而使策略扎根于同样的3D感知表征。 在VP-WorldBench和现有的4D生成基准上，点监督相比仅使用视频的对应模型提升了视频保真度和3D运动精度；在仿真与真实机器人实验中，它还提高了启用动作的模型的操作成功率。
